Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, Agentic SDLC - (EMEA Only)&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;strong&gt;An overview of this role&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;GitLab\u2019s Forward Deployed Engineering team is a field-situated product engineering function focused on strategic customer outcomes, artificial intelligence (AI) adoption, and direct contributions to GitLab\u2019s product. This isn&#39;t a traditional field engineering, solutions architecture, or professional services role. As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you&#39;ll work closely with customers while maintaining the technical standards and contribution discipline of a Staff-level product engineer.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You&#39;ll work where strategic customer urgency, complex technical ambiguity, and GitLab product execution intersect. You&#39;ll partner directly with strategic customers and teams across Product, Engineering, Support, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Solutions Architecture (SA), Customer Success Architecture (CSA), Customer Success Management (CSM), and Professional Services. You&#39;ll diagnose and resolve high-impact adoption blockers, contribute production-quality fixes and features, and turn what you learn into repeatable patterns for GitLab and its customers.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Why this role exists&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Strategic customers sometimes encounter challenges that are too broad, deep, urgent, or cross-functional for any single team to own from start to finish. These challenges may involve product gaps, performance degradation, scale bottlenecks, AI governance, adoption blockers, architectural constraints, Git usage patterns, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI\/CD) complexity, application programming interface (API) automation, security requirements, or operational instability.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Forward Deployed Engineering provides technical stewardship in these moments. The team doesn&#39;t simply observe, report, or escalate. You&#39;ll engage directly, diagnose the underlying technical problem, collaborate with the right teams, contribute code or technical solutions where appropriate, and transition the outcome into normal ownership once the customer is stable and the learning can be reused.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you\u2019ll do&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Product contribution&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Contribute production-quality code to GitLab\u2019s product and adjacent systems.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Develop bug fixes, features, integrations, tooling, and performance improvements when strategic customer outcomes require direct engineering work.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Work within GitLab\u2019s product and engineering processes, including issue discovery, merge request creation, testing, review, documentation, and maintainability.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partner with Product and Engineering so customer-driven solutions support long-term product direction rather than becoming one-off customizations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Turn blockers discovered in the field into durable product improvements, reference architectures, documentation, and repeatable implementation patterns.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Strategic technical stewardship&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Engage with strategically important customers when adoption, retention, executive confidence, or public trust is materially at risk.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Diagnose complex problems across GitLab product behavior, customer architecture, Git internals, CI\/CD workflows, API usage, observability, infrastructure, networking, and cloud environments.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Coordinate across Product, Engineering, SRE, Support, SA, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and customer technical teams to drive resolution from discovery through handoff.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Provide recommendations grounded in data, traces, and systems analysis to improve GitLab usage, workflows, automation, and architecture.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Create durable outcomes without establishing permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;AI adoption and agentic software development lifecycle&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Drive governed, measurable, and production-oriented adoption of GitLab Duo Agent Platform with strategic customers.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Identify and resolve AI adoption blockers involving governance, usage controls, auditability, security, compliance, operating models, workflow design, and integrations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Develop customer-safe adoption patterns for the agentic software development lifecycle (SDLC), AI-assisted development, intent-based review, AI governance, and human-in-the-loop software delivery.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partner with Product, Engineering, Field, and Customer Success teams to turn AI adoption learning into reusable guidance and product improvements.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Thought leadership&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Create technical narratives grounded in customer experience and product reality that can help shape the industry\u2019s approach.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Contribute to Well-Architected Frameworks, whitepapers, webinars, reference architectures, technical strategy memos, and adoption frameworks.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Guide ideas through discovery, formulation, validation, amplification, and adoption across GitLab.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partner with SA, CSA, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Product Marketing Management, CSM, Support, and executive stakeholders to make technical thought leadership a shared company capability.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you\u2019ll bring&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Staff-level experience building, operating, or improving complex production software systems.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience contributing to large, mature product codebases with high standards for testing, maintainability, performance, and security.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong Ruby on Rails or Go experience and the ability to contribute directly to GitLab\u2019s product and adjacent systems.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience with AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows, AI governance, model evaluation, context management, prompt and workflow design, or AI adoption in enterprise environments.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience diagnosing complex system behavior across application code, data stores, infrastructure, observability, networking, APIs, and customer usage patterns.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Deep knowledge of modern DevSecOps workflows, including Git, merge requests, CI\/CD, security controls, compliance needs, and enterprise software delivery.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience working with strategic customers or senior technical stakeholders in ambiguous, high-impact situations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;The ability to coordinate across product, engineering, field, and customer teams without formal authority.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong written communication and sound judgment, including the ability to create technical narratives and distinguish reusable product work from customer-specific customization.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Strongly preferred Self-Managed.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Production experience with Ruby on Rails, Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq, Vue, TypeScript, Kubernetes, Docker, Linux, or observability Customer Success Architecture, Customer Success Management, Professional Services, Support, SRE, Product, or Engineering.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A customer-specific customization function.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Unbilled Professional Services.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A requirements-gathering role that only escalates to Product.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;An AI evangelism role disconnected from product execution.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Success measures&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Success in this role may include:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Stabilizing strategic customer adoption or retention risks.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Fixing product bugs or contributing features.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Removing AI adoption blockers for strategic accounts.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Creating reusable implementation patterns and transitioning them to long-term owners.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Producing or enabling Well-Architected Frameworks, whitepapers, webinars, or technical narratives.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Resolving cross-functional customer challenges without creating permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Equipping Product, Engineering, Support, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and SA teams with better guidance based on learning from the field.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Increasing adoption and effective use of GitLab capabilities, especially GitLab Duo and GitLab Duo Agent Platform, in targeted accounts.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About the team&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The Forward Deployed Engineering team connects strategic customer needs with GitLab product execution. The team works directly with customers and across GitLab to resolve complex adoption challenges, contribute durable product improvements, and create reusable technical guidance. Its goal is to stabilize urgent situations, improve the product, and transition ongoing ownership to the appropriate team rather than create a permanent dependency.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Ideal candidate profile&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You&#39;re a Staff-level product or platform engineer who can operate in the field without becoming field-only. You&#39;re comfortable reading traces, writing production code, debugging architecture, discussing AI governance, leading a customer technical session, opening a merge request, outlining a whitepaper, and coordinating across teams to achieve a strategic customer outcome.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You&#39;re not simply a strong communicator with technical awareness. The value of that dataset scales with the quality and scale of the publishers inside it.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This role exists to acquire and retain those publishers. The Senior Partnerships Manager, Media &amp;amp; Data owns the end-to-end pursuit of medium-to-large global media publications and publisher groups, from first conversation to signature, to live, verified data flowing, and is responsible for building the commercial value exchange that makes Awin the leading partner for a premium publisher to work with. The focus in year one is a small number of flagship, tier-one lighthouse partnerships that prove the model and become the reference cases the rest of the market follows.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This is a new, dedicated role. It is not general publisher account management: the postholder is hired to spearhead these relationships and nothing else.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Key Responsibilities&lt;\/strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Land flagship media partnerships&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build and own a global target list of medium-to-large media publications and publisher groups whose audience, content and commerce activity make them high-value contributors to Awin\u2019s deterministic dataset.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own the full pursuit cycle for those targets: identify, qualify, pitch, negotiate, close and hand into onboarding, personally leading senior conversations with commercial, ecommerce, editorial and digital leadership.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Deliver a defined number of tier-one lighthouse partnerships in year one: signed tracking addendum, technically onboarded, and verifiably recording events at agreed volume and quality thresholds.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Convert those wins into reference cases, including case studies, joint narratives and referenceable contacts, that materially shorten the sales cycle for the next tranche of publishers.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Build the publisher value proposition&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own and continuously sharpen the answer to \u201cwhat\u2019s in it for the publisher\u201d: the commercial, editorial and strategic reasons a premium media owner shares CDN and wider data signals with Awin.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Construct and negotiate the value exchange, including new revenue lines, advertiser demand, insight and benchmarking, or commercial terms&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Work with Product, Marketing and the workstream owners to translate AI-visibility and full-funnel capability into publisher-facing propositions, collateral and retailer pricing&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Help each partner build their own value proposition, so the publisher has something new and differentiated to sell to advertisers, not simply a new tag on their site.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Equip partners to sell that proposition through joint collateral, benchmarks, proof points and training for their commercial and editorial teams.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Feed publisher objections, commercial expectations and market intelligence back into the project roadmap so the product earns the deals rather than the deals stretching the product.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Own the technical and contractual path to live&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Run the integration conversation with publishes, covering CDN\/edge worker or plugin deployment, tag and consent implications, data scope and page performance, with Awin product brought in for deep technical detail.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own the commercial and legal process end to end, including tracking addendum, data-sharing terms, privacy and consent positions, working with Legal and Privacy to reach repeatable rather than bespoke agreements.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Hold partners accountable to going live and staying live, tracking signed-to-verified-event conversion&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Global reach and internal leadership&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Operate globally from day one across UK, EU and US, coordinating with local Awin market and Publisher Development teams and identified regional representatives rather than duplicating them.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Act as the single point of accountability and internal voice for media partner acquisition within the project: represent the workstream in relevant forums and provide clear, honest pipeline and progress reporting to SteerCo level.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partner with the advertiser-facing teams so publisher supply and advertiser demand are sequenced together: the data has to be sold on as well as signed up.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Represent Awin externally at key industry events, conferences and partner forums to promote Unlock the Clock and Awin\u2019s fuller-funnel measurement strategy to the media community.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build the playbook: document what works, so the model can be scaled by others and, in time, by a small team reporting into this role.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Success measures (first 12 months)&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Signed and live tier-one lighthouse partnerships against an agreed target, evidenced by verified event volume&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A qualified, weighted global pipeline of medium-to-large media groups with credible forward visibility.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A repeatable publisher proposition and commercial framework: not a series of bespoke negotiations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partner-facing value propositions live in market, with at least two partners actively selling an Awin-enabled proposition of their own.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Referenceable partners willing to advocate publicly, at least one flagship case study in market, and Awin represented on stage at relevant industry events.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Measurable advertiser-side pull-through from the partnerships landed, agreed jointly with the advertiser teams.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Key Skills&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;7+ years in commercial, partnership or account leadership roles, with a significant portion earned publisher-side or media-owner-side.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;An established personal network of senior contacts across the media and publishing world that can be activated from day one. This is a prerequisite, not a nice-to-have.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience representing an organisation publicly: speaking at industry events, on panels or at partner forums.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Demonstrable track record of senior-level relationships inside premium publishers or media groups, including commercial directors, heads of ecommerce, editorial and digital leadership.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience negotiating and closing commercial agreements with, or on behalf of, publishers: tenancy, CPC, CPA, fixed fee, data or licensing deals.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Working knowledge of the affiliate and performance ecosystem and how publishers monetise content, for example Awin, Skimlinks, Rakuten, Partnerize, Impact or similar.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience selling or landing something new, a product, model or proposition without an established category, rather than managing an existing book of business.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Comfortable navigating multi-stakeholder deals spanning commercial, editorial, legal, privacy and technical teams.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;International exposure across at least two of UK, US and DACH\/EMEA markets.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Desirable: experience with content licensing, AI\/LLM discovery, SEO\/AEO, or data partnership deals.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Commercially creative, able to construct a value exchange where no price list exists.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Relationship builder with genuine credibility at senior level.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong negotiator, comfortable with ambiguity and long sales cycles.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Excellent storyteller: can turn technical capability into a publisher-relevant revenue narrative.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Confident, credible public speaker, comfortable on stage and in front of a room as a visible advocate for Awin\u2019s strategy.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Self-starting and resilient. This is a build role, not a maintain role.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Collaborative and low-ego; comfortable pulling in engineering, legal, product and local market teams.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Analytically confident: fluent in performance data, able to interrogate reporting and defend a number.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strategic mindset paired with a bias to action and closing.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Technically literate rather than technical: able to hold a credible conversation about tags, tracking, CDNs and edge\/worker deployments, page performance and data flows, and to know when to bring engineering into the room.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Confident with analytics and reporting platforms, including GA4, publisher analytics, BI dashboards and Excel or Sheets.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Comfortable working with privacy and consent concepts, including GDPR and consent frameworks, as they affect publisher data sharing.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Fluent English essential. German or another European language advantageous.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Willingness to travel to relevant markets as required&lt;strong&gt;.&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;TypographyPresentation TypographyPresentation--medium RichText3-paragraph--withVSpacingNormal RichText3-paragraph HighlightSol HighlightSol--buildingBlock&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Our Offer&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;ul class=&quot;RichTextList-bulleted&quot;&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;TypographyPresentation TypographyPresentation--medium RichText3-paragraph--withVSpacingNormal RichText3-paragraph HighlightSol HighlightSol--buildingBlock&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Flexi-Week&lt;\/strong&gt;: We prioritise your mental health and wellbeing by offering you a four-day Flexi-Week (with one lighter or completely disconnected day per week) at full pay, with no reduction to your annual holiday allowance.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;TypographyPresentation TypographyPresentation--medium RichText3-paragraph--withVSpacingNormal RichText3-paragraph HighlightSol HighlightSol--buildingBlock&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Flexi-Office&lt;\/strong&gt;: We offer an international culture and flexibility through our hybrid working model, designed to foster collaboration, trust, and autonomy.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;div class=&quot;TypographyPresentation TypographyPresentation--medium RichText3-paragraph--withVSpacingNormal RichText3-paragraph HighlightSol HighlightSol--buildingBlock&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Work Expense Contribution &amp;amp; As a leader in the industry, Klaviyo is committed to innovation, customer success, and fostering a collaborative work environment.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Named as one of the UK\u2019s \u2018Great Places To Work\u2019 for the third year running, we are looking for individuals who want to join our dedicated team and help us grow our already impressive customer base in EMEA even further.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We&#39;re seeking passionate &lt;strong&gt;Customer Success Professionals (CSMs)&lt;\/strong&gt; for our new state of the art and dynamic London office who thrive in a hybrid working environment (3 days in the office). Our mission is to exceed customer expectations and drive their growth. We&#39;re looking for CSMs who are dedicated to delivering the best experience to our EMEA customers.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;This is an exciting opportunity for someone with a customer-first attitude, strong consultative and technical skills, and a proven track record of creatively solving unique problems in a fast-paced environment.&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Ideal candidates will have a strong background in CRM, Campaign Management, Data and Analytics, Digital, E-Commerce, or Marketing Technology Solutions.&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;How you will make a difference:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Transform workflows by putting AI at the centre, building smarter systems and ways of working from the ground up.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Be passionate about customer success and establish yourself as the trusted advisor for Klaviyo\u2019s enterprise business.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Drive positive Net Revenue Retention by mitigating churn risk and identifying opportunities for customer expansion and upgrades.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Devise customized success plans based on customers&#39; goals and challenges, holding customers accountable for driving action.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Compose strategies to increase email, SMS, and digital channel revenue for all customers through the Klaviyo platform while driving growth and expansion.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Proactively review customer performance, address any open issues, and ensure consistent messaging and appropriate escalation.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Keep customers up to date on product releases and new features.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Share feedback with Product\/Engineering to enhance customer engagement.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Contribute to a positive team environment of collaboration, customer empathy, equality, and inclusion.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Who you are:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;5+ years of customer success or account management with a track record for building and nurturing relationships with multiple stakeholders on an account at a time.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;An experienced marketer with a background in campaign management, CRM, digital marketing, data, or analytics.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You\u2019ve already experimented with AI in work or personal projects, and you\u2019re excited to dive in and learn fast. You\u2019re hungry to responsibly explore new AI tools and workflows, finding ways to make your work smarter and more efficient.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Familiarity with Marketing Automation technologies.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A proven track record of advising customers or executing marketing strategies.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Customer success or account management experience with a history of building and nurturing relationships with multiple stakeholders.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience explaining how to achieve key goals using software with end users.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A track record of creative problem-solving for customers and end users.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Comfortable discussing and supporting commercial conversations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Thrives in a collaborative environment.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Excellent organizational and project management skills.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Excellent communication skills via phone, video conference, and email.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Curious and eager to learn.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Adaptable to change and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience with G-Suite, Gainsight, Salesforce, or similar tools.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;#LI-Hybrid&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-weight: 400;&quot;&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-pay-transparency&quot;&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;pay-input&quot;&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;description&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;Our salary range reflects the cost of labour in the country where the job post is advertised. The base salary offered for this position is determined by several factors, including the applicant\u2019s job-related skills, relevant experience, education or training, and work location.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;In addition to base salary, our total compensation package may include participation in the company\u2019s annual cash bonus plan, variable compensation (OTE) for sales and customer success roles, equity, sign-on payments, and a comprehensive range of health, welfare, and wellbeing benefits based on eligibility.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Your recruiter can provide more details about the specific salary\/OTE&amp;nbsp; range for your preferred location during the hiring process.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;title&quot;&gt;Base Pay Range in Local Currency:&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;pay-range&quot;&gt;&lt;span&gt;\u00a372,000&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;divider&quot;&gt;&amp;mdash;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span&gt;\u00a3108,000 GBP&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;This role may require up to 10% travel for purposes such as new hire onboarding, client or partner work if applicable, team meetings, and industry events. To reach our goals, we need our own crew of remarkable creators\u2014ambitious and collaborative teammates who stay focused on our north star: delighting our customers. It\u2019s big, it\u2019s bold, and we\u2019re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-weight: 400;&quot;&gt;If you\u2019re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;div&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;THE WORK:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are growing, and so is the breadth and depth of our marketing programs, with AI at the core of how we scale. We are looking for a highly motivated, diligent, and data-driven Senior Marketing Analytics Manager to join our Marketing Operations team. Reporting into the Director, Marketing Operations and Demand Generation, this role will serve as the analytical backbone of our growth marketing engine \u2014 leading the measurement, visualization, and insights infrastructure that drives smarter investment decisions and executive-level confidence in our marketing performance.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;In this role, you will own analytics and reporting across all growth marketing functions, from campaign performance to pipeline attribution. You&#39;ll partner closely with Growth Marketing, Finance, RevOps, and other cross-functional teams to ensure data is accurate, accessible, and actionable across the full funnel. You&#39;ll also be a practitioner and champion of AI-powered tools \u2014 using them to automate workflows, accelerate insight generation, and elevate the sophistication of our marketing measurement at scale.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You&#39;ll use data to continuously improve reporting efficiency, forecast accuracy, and budget allocation decisions, helping ensure our marketing analytics engine drives measurable impact on pipeline and revenue.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;WHAT YOU\u2019LL DO:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own analytics and end-to-end measurement across all growth marketing functions, ensuring consistent and actionable reporting from spend to revenue.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead the visualization and reporting infrastructure across growth marketing, translating complex data into clear, compelling dashboards and narratives for stakeholders at all levels.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead pipeline attribution, ROI, CAC, LTV, and Ad spend distribution analyses to inform investment decisions, and partner with Growth Marketing, Finance, and RevOps on spend pacing and forecasting.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Evolve attribution modeling and performance measurement frameworks, using AI and machine learning to improve accuracy and scalability.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Apply AI-powered tools and predictive modeling to surface proactive insights, identify trends, and support faster, more confident decision-making across the marketing team.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Empower experimentation programs with thorough data-driven insights, Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.<\/p><\/div><h2>Staff Software Engineer<\/h2>\n<p>Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and partners every day.<\/p>\n<p>From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers Deliveroo's growth at scale.<\/p>\n<p>In November 2023 we launched our non-food retail offering, Deliveroo 'Shopping', where we work with large and small merchants. We oversee all operations within the grocery and retail ecosystem, ensuring stores are equipped to receive and efficiently process orders. Our solutions empower stores to manage orders seamlessly through multiple channels, including our in-house app, API integration, and devices pre-installed with our software. Additionally, we provide tools to maintain and update product catalogs, ensuring accurate inventory for consumers. The technology we've developed enables our partners to pick the correct items swiftly while keeping inventory data current, optimizing both efficiency and accuracy.<\/p>\n<p>We're looking for a <strong>Staff Software Engineer<\/strong> to join our <strong>London, UK - Hybrid (3 days from the office)<\/strong> team. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century\u2019s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril\u2019s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;h3&gt;ABOUT THE TEAM&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The Maneuver Dominance team at Anduril develops operationally relevant, multi-asset autonomy. We are focused on making large groups of autonomous systems work effectively together. We leverage existing Anduril drone platforms like Ghost or Altius, in addition to bringing 3rd party platforms into Anduril\u2019s Lattice ecosystem.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;ABOUT THE JOB&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are seeking a Senior Robotics Software Engineer, Omen Payload Integration to join the Maneuver Dominance team in Abu Dhabi (UAE). In this role, you will design, develop, and integrate software that connects autonomous platforms with mission payloads, including stores management systems (SMS), networked devices, and hardware interfaces. You will architect APIs and data transport layers that move information reliably between vehicles, payloads, and ground systems in demanding operational environments.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy solving complex problems at the intersection of software, networking, and hardware, and are passionate about delivering mission-critical systems, this opportunity is for you.&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What You\u2019ll Do&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Develop Networked Software:&lt;\/strong&gt; Engineer scalable, robust software that interacts with networking devices, managed networks, and common router or switch hardware.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Payload &amp;amp; SMS Integration:&lt;\/strong&gt; Design and implement software that interfaces with stores management systems (SMS) and other payload subsystems to coordinate the release and control of munitions and mission payloads.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;API\/ICD Design:&lt;\/strong&gt; Architect and implement software APIs and Interface Control Documents (ICDs) using HTTP, REST, and gRPC to connect distributed systems across vehicles, payloads, and ground stations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Data Transport Engineering:&lt;\/strong&gt; Build and optimize low-level data transport over UDP and TCP, ensuring reliable, low-latency communication in constrained operational environments.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Hardware-Interfacing Software:&lt;\/strong&gt; Write code that interfaces directly with hardware, bridging embedded devices, sensors, and payload electronics with higher-level autonomy software.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Collaborate Cross-Functionally:&lt;\/strong&gt; Partner with hardware, systems, vehicle, and payload teams to seamlessly integrate software into physical platforms.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Real-World Deployment:&lt;\/strong&gt; Travel up to 25% to test, debug, and deploy systems in operational environments.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Iterative Development:&lt;\/strong&gt; As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;At Anduril we are building multi-domain unmanned systems that will leverage unsupervised autonomy for the delivery of integrated multi-mission capability to our customers. Dive-XL is a large-displacement AUV program designed and built in Australia, all in-house. Our Manufacturing engineering team is growing and now seeking a Manufacturing Test Engineer with an Electronic, Mechatronic or Computer Science background to join our team as a Test Systems Engineer to enable rapid testing of cutting-edge defence hardware for undersea and flight vehicles. As a Manufacturing Test Engineer, you will have responsibility for optimizing Anduril\u2019s manufacturing test operations for best-in-class quality, reliability, speed, and asset utilization, all while meeting critical customer and internal development timelines.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About the role&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;As a Test Systems Engineer you will own the technical backbone of Manufacturing Test for Dive-XL \u2014 the frameworks, GUIs, automation, and tester integrations that the production team uses to bring up PCBAs, build bottles, check out systems, and accept vehicles at FAT. Hardware-meets-software work, on the floor, in production.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;Concretely, the two flagship things you&#39;ll build:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;The manufacturing-line console. Pre-programmed for PCBA bring-up and bottle bring-up. Technicians execute curated, version-controlled tests through a GUI. They do not author command-line.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;The vehicle-level test base. A pre-programmed console for vehicle Factory Acceptance Test and system check-out. Same as manufacturing-line console.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Behind both: one framework, one config-managed toolchain, one OS target for test execution, and a CI\/CD discipline for test code that today doesn&#39;t exist.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;strong&gt;WHAT YOU\u2019LL DO&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Design and build a production utility suite of tools. From requirements through architecture, through GUI development, through deployment to the floor. These are the two consoles that the production team will live in.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Test framework architecture. The shared substrate underneath both consoles \u2014 test runners, instrumentation drivers, data logging, traceability hooks, error-code library, configuration management.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Toolchain standardisation. NixOS-based, declarative, reproducible. Drive the move off mixed Linux\/ Windows\/ Mac\/ NixOS dev environments to a single config-managed target.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;CI\/CD for test code. Test software ships through pipelines, not over USB sticks. Stand it up, maintain it, hold the line on review and version control.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Integration with Anduril&#39;s factory systems: MES (work instructions, routings, defect capture), Oracle ERP, Teamcenter PLM where relevant. Test results should land in the systems where they&#39;re traced and acted on, not in spreadsheets.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Technician-facing usability. GUIs that lower the entry-skill bar. Curated, version-controlled tests. Clear pass\/fail. Helpful error codes that point at the actual problem, not at a stack trace.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Cross-site codebase convergence with other Anduril production sites. You&#39;re part of converging the AU and US Manufacturing Test stacks \u2014 shared framework, shared XL Utility code, common error-code library. You&#39;ll work with the US team to make that real.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Floor support. When a test fails and it&#39;s not clear whether it&#39;s the product, the tester, or the test code \u2014 you debug it. You&#39;re the one called when the GUI throws an unexpected error and the build&#39;s stopped.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;strong&gt;REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Engineering fundamentals. Degree in Software, Computer, Electrical, Mechatronic, or related engineering \u2014 or equivalent demonstrable experience. You can read a schematic and reason about what the test code is actually exercising.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong software fluency for test automation. Python first, with real experience building, maintaining, and debugging test frameworks \u2014 not just scripts. You write code other people can read, change, and ship.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Linux + command line as a primary environment. You live in a shell. You write Bash where it makes sense. You&#39;re comfortable with system-level configuration, process management, and network debugging \u2014 not as a special skill, just as how you work.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Hardware-software interface fluency. You&#39;ve written software that drives test instruments and hardware-under-test through real interfaces \u2014 USB, Ethernet, RS232\/RS485, CAN, I2C, SPI, GPIB, or equivalent.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Electronics troubleshooting hands-on. You can pick up an oscilloscope, a multimeter, or a logic analyser and isolate whether a problem is in the product, the tester, or the cable between them. You don&#39;t escalate the question \u2014 you get hands on and answer it.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;GUI development experience. You&#39;ve built user-facing test consoles or operator interfaces \u2014 frameworks vary (PyQt, Tkinter, web stacks, LabVIEW front panels) but you understand what makes a tech-facing GUI usable vs frustrating, and you can ship one.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Software-engineering discipline. You version-control test code. You write tests for the test code where it matters. You think about reproducibility, configuration management, and rollback before they bite.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Bias to action and ownership. You see a fragmented toolchain and your reaction is to fix it, not to log a ticket. You&#39;re comfortable being the one who decides what the framework looks like.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Clearance eligibility. Ability to obtain and maintain an Australian Government NV2 Security Clearance (Australian citizen).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;strong&gt;PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Production test environments \u2014 not just R&amp;amp;D test benches. Building software that has to survive a production floor, technicians under time pressure, and shift handovers is its own discipline.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;NixOS or other declarative-configuration systems (Ansible, Puppet, Chef). The target is NixOS; coachable from any solid declarative-config background.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Test frameworks like LabVIEW, TestStand, pytest-based test harnesses, or equivalent \u2014 exposure to more than one is a plus.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience working with \u2014 or building toward \u2014 common test metrics: first-pass yield, false-fail rate, tester utilisation, GR&amp;amp;R, test coverage.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;MES (Solumina, Ae), ERP (Oracle \/ SAP \/ NetSuite), or PLM (Teamcenter) integration experience.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Subsea robotics or AUV\/UUV domain experience.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;AS9100 \/ ISO 9001 environments and the configuration-management discipline that comes with them.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Embedded firmware \u2014 flashing, debugging, reading datasheets, talking to bootloaders.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience integrating with hazardous systems (high voltage up to 400V, hydraulics, compressed gas) \u2014 and the safety design that goes with it.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;auto&quot;&gt;The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;h3&gt;About the Team&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Anduril\u2019s Maritime Division has assembled a diverse team of experts in software, robotics, artificial intelligence, sensor fusion, and data analysis to create software and hardware solutions that radically evolve the capabilities of our customers. We are fielding the next generation of autonomous systems to tackle the extremely challenging industry demands of maritime operations. Anduril has brought to market a unique, ultra-long-range, full-ocean-depth underwater vessel platform and a completely refreshed maritime vehicle and flexible manufacturing architecture that scales from &quot;small&quot; to &quot;extra-large&quot; vehicle sizes. Today, Anduril is executing on billion-dollar contracts while simultaneously performing Robot-as-a-Service (RaaS) AUV operations.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;We are seeking to sustain our early successes with deep investment in an expanded product portfolio. These products, including Dive-XL, Dive-LD, Copperhead, Seabed Sentry, and other unannounced systems, will deliver a coherent system-of-systems, enabling the end-to-end conduct of a variety of autonomous missions in the maritime domain. If you are passionate about solving problems that have real impact and working on systems that directly contribute to achieving national strategic priorities, we want you to join Anduril\u2019s Maritime Division and help us build the future of defence capability.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;About the Job&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Software Engineering Managers independently lead teams to deliver a variety of software integrated in to our products. This includes autonomy, simulation, data processing, payload integration, and off-board command and control or decision support. We expect Software Engineering Managers to demonstrate end-to-end outcome ownership of a major system within an integrated product, and the team responsible for building and maintaining it. Software Engineering Managers contribute as a team lead to the rapid architecting, design, delivery, support, and evolution of next generation autonomous platforms through their entire product life-cycle.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;What You\u2019ll Do&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Empathize with end-users and drive solutions that balance their needs with external constraints, restrictions and requirements in a multi-stakeholder environment&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Be accountable for software enabled solutions that are deployed to customers, optimizing for the delivery of value to the end-user&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Collaborate with your Technical Lead to architect scalable software that rapidly delivers capability beyond the scope of current platforms, with a clear path for both architecture and capability evolution over time&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Co-ordinate your teams roadmap and execution with other teams across Anduril, with the aim of developing components that are re-usable across multiple Anduril product lines&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Contribute to the design, implementation and execution of development processes for the initial delivery and subsequent iteration of vehicle and mission software, including full lifecycle testing, monitoring and operation&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Manage a 6 - 18 month roadmap for your team, nested within broader organisational roadmap&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Manage an allocated budget for your team&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Manage programatic risk for your team, and collaborate with your Technical Lead to manage technical risk, including sound and timely decision making&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead by example as a technically competent, trustworthy, and accountable team lead&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Communicate organizational vision, strategy, and direction to your team.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Define, document, gain consensus for, and communicate appropriate goals and plans for your team, derived from broader organizational vision, strategy, and priorities&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build your team through mentoring, professional development, career management, and collaboration with Anduril\u2019s recruiting and people functions&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Work as a leader of a multi-disciplinary engineering team of 4 - 10 members, including as a mentor and manager for Engineers from differing backgrounds&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Report to a manager who may or may not have a background in software engineering&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Travel to co-locate with end-users and\/or other teams up to As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;The &lt;strong&gt;Business Development (BD)&lt;\/strong&gt; team, within Anduril\u2019s Growth &lt;strong&gt;organisation&lt;\/strong&gt;, is responsible for identifying, shaping, capturing, and growing new opportunities and capabilities for the company. Monzo Business Banking is fast-growing, is the UK\u2019s most recommended business account for overall service quality. We recently hit 1 million customers and are used by 1 in 6 UK SMEs.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We want to help businesses spend less time on financial admin and more time focused on running and growing their business. businesses.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Whether it\u2019s helping businesses understand their cash flow, reducing manual admin, surfacing the right insight at the right moment, or helping teams build on&lt;\/h1&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As a Lead Machine Learning Scientist, you\u2019ll be a technical leader and hands-on individual contributor, spearheading our ML and GenAI capabilities and shipping key models that powers magical Business Banking experiences.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You\u2019ll:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Be one of the first ML Scientists in Business Banking, bringing leadership through ambiguity by adding structure and direction to our ML capabilities while staying agile and building momentum.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Develop and deploy advanced ML models on our cloud-native data platform to serve hundreds of thousands of business customers.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partner with Product, data science and other stakeholders to identify the highest-impact opportunities, size if&lt;\/h1&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;What we\u2019re doing here at Monzo excites you!&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You have a multiple year track record of excellence leading the development and deployment models to production and delivering business impact.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You&#39;re impact-driven and excited to own the end-to-end journey that starts with a business problem and ends with your solution having a measurable impact in production.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You have a self-starter mindset; you proactively identify issues and opportunities and tackle them without being told to do so.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You speak Python fluently and have extensive, hands-on experience with &lt;code&gt;scikit-learn&lt;\/code&gt;. especially in financial products where trust, transparency and customer control matter.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h1&gt;Nice to haves&lt;\/h1&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience working on personalisation, ranking, recommendation, forecasting, classification or decisioning problems for customer-facing applications.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience working on ML systems for fintech, banking, accounting, payments, lending, invoicing, cash flow, tax, risk or business software.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience with GenAI, LLMs, agentic workflows, retrieval, evaluation frameworks, or human-in-the-loop product experiences.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Commercial experience writing critical production code and working with microservices.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience designing experiments, A\/B tests or other approaches to measure product and customer impact.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience working in regulated environments or with products where explainability, auditability and customer trust are especially important.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h1&gt;The interview process&lt;\/h1&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Our interview process involves 3 main stages. We make SumUp Consumer, the wallet app that lets everyday consumers pay SumUp merchants with a tap, send money to friends, track their spending and earn loyalty rewards along the way.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As we grow SumUp Consumer across new markets and features, we need sharp, reliable insight into how people discover, adopt and use the product \u2014 and how that behaviour translates into sustainable commercial growth. This includes understanding our acquisition funnel, improving activation and conversion, increasing customer value, and reducing churn.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We\u2019re looking for a Product Data Analyst to join the Consumer tribe and become the analytical partner for SumUp Consumer. You\u2019ll work closely with Product Managers, Designers and Engineers, alongside our Analytics Engineering team, to understand customer behaviour, shape product strategy, and connect product performance to business outcomes.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You\u2019ll help answer questions such as:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Which acquisition channels and customer segments generate the strongest long-term value?&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Where do customers drop out of the journey from acquisition to activation?&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;What drives repeat usage, retention and churn?&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Which product changes improve conversion, customer value or commercial performance?&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;How should we prioritise product investments across markets and customer segments?&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;If you\u2019re motivated by meaningful analytical work, enjoy translating complexity into clarity, and want to see your insights directly influence both product decisions and commercial outcomes, this role is for you.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you\u2019ll do&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Analyse customer behaviour and product performance across the full consumer lifecycle \u2014 from &lt;strong&gt;acquisition and activation through engagement, retention, churn and reactivation&lt;\/strong&gt;.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Identify opportunities to improve conversion, customer value and sustainable growth using funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation and behavioural analytics.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers and Data teams to ensure decisions are grounded in robust analysis, customer insight and commercial understanding.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Evaluate the performance of customer segments, markets, channels and product journeys, helping the team understand where growth opportunities and commercial trade-offs exist.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Support decisions that improve key business outcomes, such as activation, conversion, repeat usage, retention, churn, customer lifetime value and revenue-related metrics.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Conduct exploratory analysis to answer product and business questions, translating complex data into clear, commercially relevant recommendations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Define, monitor and communicate core SumUp Consumer KPIs, covering acquisition, activation, engagement, conversion, retention, churn and customer value.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Design, execute and analyse A\/B tests and product experiments, assessing both customer impact and commercial impact.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build and maintain dashboards and reporting that stakeholders actively use, proactively surfacing trends, anomalies, performance risks and growth opportunities.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Help Product Managers assess the expected impact of opportunities and evaluate whether product investments are delivering the intended customer and business outcomes.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partner with Analytics Engineering to ensure KPI definitions, business logic and product instrumentation are accurate, scalable and trusted.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Bring a curious eye to AI and machine learning techniques, including LLM-assisted analysis, to speed up insight generation, customer understanding and product measurement.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;You\u2019ll be great for this role if\u2026&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You have strong SQL skills and are comfortable querying, analysing and validating data in a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery or similar.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You have hands-on experience with product analytics techniques such as funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation and behavioural analysis.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You understand the commercial drivers of a digital product, including customer acquisition, conversion, activation, retention, churn and customer lifetime value.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You can connect customer behaviour and product performance to business outcomes, and use data to identify growth opportunities and inform prioritisation.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You\u2019ve worked on A\/B tests or product experiments, with a solid grounding in the statistics behind them.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You\u2019re proficient in a visualisation tool such as Looker, Tableau or Power BI, with a track record of building dashboards that stakeholders actually use.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You can translate ambiguous product or business questions into structured analysis, and explain findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences alike.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You\u2019re comfortable assessing trade-offs, challenging assumptions and making recommendations based on evidence.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You\u2019re curious about how AI and emerging techniques can improve product measurement, experimentation, customer understanding and commercial decision-making.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You\u2019re comfortable managing multiple workstreams and stakeholders, with strong prioritisation and a proactive communication style.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;This role does not support Visa sponsorship and candidates must have the right to work in the We now have the opportunity to turn that reach into one of the world&#39;s largest consumer financial ecosystems.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Our consumer product is already live across six European markets. Ces demandes n&#39;affectent pas le r\u00e9sultat du processus de recrutement.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;\ud83c\uddec\ud83c\udde7 ENGLISH VERSION&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Our Decathlon App team is looking for a Staff Product Manager (f\/m\/d) on a Permanent Contract (CDI) based in Lille or Paris.&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;At the core of Decathlon&#39;s digital ecosystem, the &lt;strong&gt;Decathlon App&lt;\/strong&gt; team acts as the ultimate bridge between our digital commerce and physical store experiences. Our mission goes beyond transactions: we are building an indispensable daily sports companion for millions of users. Joining our global mobile team (iOS &amp;amp; Android) means evolving in a high-impact environment where autonomy, scaling challenges, and product excellence drive everything we do.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;YOUR FUTURE CONTRIBUTION&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As a Staff Product Manager (f\/m\/d), you will provide the strategic direction and functional architecture needed to scale our mobile platform across multiple product teams. Operating with high autonomy, you will address complex challenges to shape our long-term app experience and guarantee ecosystem cohesion.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Your mission centers on 4 strategic pillars:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Strategic Alignment, Stakeholder Management &amp;amp; App Vision&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own the holistic value (&lt;em&gt;macro view&lt;\/em&gt;) generated by key mobile initiatives across the business and customer ecosystem, moving beyond individual squad backlogs.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Deliver high-impact narratives and presentations to executive leadership, business directors, and cross-functional stakeholders to align the organization on major platform shifts and app roadmaps.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Set strategic direction for key user segments across native mobile touchpoints.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Track and optimize macro success metrics across the entire journey: Awareness, Traffic, Conversion, Retention, and Repeat Purchase Rate.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Functional Architecture &amp;amp; End-to-End Orchestration&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Act as the lead Functional Architect, defining how functional scope and boundaries are distributed across app feature squads to eliminate overlap and friction.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Work in tight Triad Collaboration with Staff\/Principal Engineers and Staff UX Designers to align technical architecture, mobile design systems, and product vision.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Design seamless, connected user journeys linking mobile discovery, in-store interactions (e.g., Scan &amp;amp; Go, store pickup), checkout, and sports services.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Strategic Sparring &amp;amp; Product De-Risking&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Serve as a trusted strategic advisor and sparring partner for Group Product Managers (GPMs) and PMs to help them navigate complex app dependencies and product traps.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Formulate and drive product de-risking strategies for high-stakes app initiatives, identifying desirability, viability, and usability risks early in discovery.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Design and run concrete validation loops (A\/B tests, multivariate testing, prototype usability tests) to validate hypotheses before engineering deployment.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Elevating Product Craft &amp;amp; Mastery&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Upskill the PM community on modern product practices, standardizing discovery frameworks, continuous experimentation, and Opportunity Solution Trees (OST).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Drive organizational adoption of AI-first possibilities and advanced product methodologies to amplify app experience and squad efficiency.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Act as a force multiplier: elevate the collective bar of the product management community without operating as a formal people manager.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Mobile Native Expertise&lt;\/strong&gt;: Proven track record (7+ years) in Product Management with deep hands-on experience scaling native mobile applications (iOS &amp;amp; Android) in high-scale digital environments.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;E-Commerce &amp;amp; Retail Complexity&lt;\/strong&gt;: Solid background in e-commerce, digital platforms, or omnichannel retail where digital products connect directly with physical operational touchpoints.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Transverse Scale&lt;\/strong&gt;: Demonstrated experience driving cross-squad alignment and architectural initiatives across multi-team product organizations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Native App Product Strategy&lt;\/strong&gt;: Deep understanding of iOS\/Android design paradigms, app store mechanics, mobile analytics, and push engagement strategies.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Product Discovery &amp;amp; De-Risking&lt;\/strong&gt;: Expertise in quantitative and qualitative discovery methods, CRO, A\/B testing frameworks, and Opportunity Solution Trees (OST).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Functional Architecture &amp;amp; Scoping&lt;\/strong&gt;: Ability to structure complex business problems into clear MVP\/V0\/V1 scoping playbooks and boundary maps.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Executive Communication &amp;amp; Storytelling&lt;\/strong&gt;: Ability to translate complex product architectures, UX metrics, and data insights into clear, persuasive executive presentations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;AI &amp;amp; Modern Product Stack&lt;\/strong&gt;: Curiosity and practical experience integrating AI capabilities into product workflows and user experiences.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Soft Skills &amp;amp; Behaviors:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strategic Influence &amp;amp; Emotional Intelligence (influencing without hierarchical authority).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Thriving in Ambiguity (highly autonomous self-starter).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Triad &amp;amp; Cross-Functional Collaboration (Staff Tech, Staff Design, UXR, Data, Business).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Growth Mindset &amp;amp; Empathy (humble approach and dedicating time to mentor).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;WHAT WE OFFER YOU&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Hybrid work organization;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Equipment provided tailored to your role and our sustainability commitments (Mac or Windows);&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Local project team within a global network (international career opportunities);&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Continuous skills development and support (diverse projects, internal and external training, etc.);&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Comprehensive compensation package (employee stock ownership, monthly\/quarterly bonuses).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION AND ACCESSIBILITY&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;At Decathlon, we recognize the immense value that diversity brings to our teams, and we continuously strive to foster and cultivate an inclusive and equitable workplace: this is why Inclusion is one of our Human Fundamentals. We encourage people of all backgrounds and abilities to apply, as we are convinced that diversity of thought, culture, identity, and lived experience makes us stronger. Decathlon is also committed to offering an inclusive and accessible recruitment process for all candidates. If you require any reasonable accommodations during the process, you can request them via the application form, and your request will remain confidential. These requests will not affect the outcome of your hiring process.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;DECATHLON DIGITAL&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les fronti\u00e8res et d&#39;offrir des exp\u00e9riences sportives in\u00e9dites. C&#39;est pr\u00e9cis\u00e9ment notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une \u00e9quipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ing\u00e9nierie logicielle, gestion de produits, donn\u00e9es, cloud et cybers\u00e9curit\u00e9, r\u00e9partis \u00e0 Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous cr\u00e9ons la plus vaste plateforme sportive num\u00e9rique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la cha\u00eene de valeur, concevoir des exp\u00e9riences connect\u00e9es et donner une seconde vie \u00e0 nos produits.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Changeons la donne pour de bon.&lt;\/strong&gt; Notre passion du sport nous guide et nous voulons qu\u2019elle perdure. C\u2019est pourquoi nous nous engageons \u00e0 b\u00e2tir un mod\u00e8le technologique plus durable, en r\u00e9duisant notre impact direct sur l&#39;environnement, et en cr\u00e9ant un espace s\u00fbr et inclusif pour apprendre et nous \u00e9panouir ensemble. du changement :&lt;\/strong&gt; Piloter les ordres de transports de bout en bout \u00e0 travers des environnements complexes (DEV, QA, PRD) en veillant au respect strict des fen\u00eatres de livraison, des jalons de bascule (&lt;em&gt;cutover&lt;\/em&gt;) et des circuits d&#39;approbation.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Pilotage des processus ChaRM :&lt;\/strong&gt; Administrer et superviser les flux de travail ChaRM dans SAP Solution Manager (changements normaux, urgents et administratifs), en r\u00e9solvant proactivement les conflits d&#39;import, les erreurs de s\u00e9quence et la gestion des &lt;em&gt;Transports of Copies&lt;\/em&gt; (ToC).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Contr\u00f4le qualit\u00e9 &amp;amp; conformit\u00e9 :&lt;\/strong&gt; Effectuer les v\u00e9rifications pr\u00e9-import, la validation des d\u00e9pendances et le suivi des collisions afin de garantir la stabilit\u00e9 des syst\u00e8mes, des d\u00e9ploiements sans interruption de service (&lt;em&gt;zero-downtime&lt;\/em&gt;) et le respect des normes d&#39;audit.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;R\u00e9solution d&#39;incidents &amp;amp; coordination Basis :&lt;\/strong&gt; Analyser et r\u00e9soudre les \u00e9checs de transport, les codes d&#39;erreur (ex: RC=8, RC=12) et les verrouillages de s\u00e9quences, en \u00e9troite collaboration avec les \u00e9quipes SAP Basis et les d\u00e9veloppeurs fonctionnels.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Modernisation &amp;amp; pour les environnements hybrides et S\/4HANA.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Alignement parties prenantes &amp;amp; Change Advisory Board (CAB) :&lt;\/strong&gt; Interagir avec le Comit\u00e9 de Validation des Changements (CAB), les responsables de &lt;em&gt;releases&lt;\/em&gt; et les chefs de projets pour planifier les calendriers de d\u00e9ploiement, g\u00e9rer les correctifs d&#39;urgence (&lt;em&gt;hotfixes&lt;\/em&gt;) et coordonner les p\u00e9riodes de gel syst\u00e8me (&lt;em&gt;freeze&lt;\/em&gt;).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;CE QUE TU APPORTES&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Exp\u00e9rience :&lt;\/strong&gt; 4 \u00e0 5 ans d&#39;exp\u00e9rience confirm\u00e9e dans la gestion des transports SAP, le pilotage de processus de change management ou l&#39;administration Solution Manager\/ChaRM.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Expertise M\u00e9tier &amp;amp; P\u00e9dagogie, bon relationnel et capacit\u00e9 \u00e0 f\u00e9d\u00e9rer des \u00e9quipes multidisciplinaires (d\u00e9veloppeurs, experts Basis, chefs de projets) autour des exigences de livraison.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Langues :&lt;\/strong&gt; Outils SAP :&lt;\/strong&gt; SAP TM, SAP Solution Manager (ChaRM), SAP Cloud ALM (CALM), SAP cTMS&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Environnements :&lt;\/strong&gt; SAP S\/4HANA, paysages multi-tier (DEV \/ QA \/ PRD)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Outillage de gestion :&lt;\/strong&gt; Vous assurez le lineage entre les concepts m\u00e9tiers et les connaissances techniques&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Accessibilit\u00e9 de la donn\u00e9e :&lt;\/strong&gt; vous traduisez les besoins m\u00e9tiers en exigences techniques d&#39;exposition, et accompagnez les Data Users dans la localisation et l&#39;utilisation des donn\u00e9es en favorisant l&#39;usage du Data Catalog. Vous vous assurez que les ingestions de donn\u00e9es dans le Datalake respectent les standards (storage zone, sch\u00e9mas, nomenclatures\u2026)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;S\u00e9curit\u00e9 &amp;amp; conformit\u00e9 :&lt;\/strong&gt; vous veillez \u00e0 ce que la donn\u00e9e reste strictement conforme aux exigences de s\u00e9curit\u00e9 et aux r\u00e8gles l\u00e9gales (ex: CNIL, RGPD, PIPL). About the role<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure into a single layer and give ISPs, hyperscalers, and AI companies a clean path to deliver connectivity into every home and business across Kenya and the continent. Behind that marketplace is a real network: a BGP edge peering with Tier 1 transit, hyperscalers, and local exchanges, an MPLS backbone, aggregation and access gear, and the systems that watch all of it.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">For the partners who run on us, the network is the product, and the NOC is where they feel it. A clean shift is a partner who never knew anything happened. That is the bar.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">We are early and the team is small, so we cannot afford a pair of hands that only knows how to escalate. We need a capable network engineer who can stand a shift, resolve real faults without waking anyone, and then keep building the network while East Africa sleeps: propagation and peering checks, health passes across the estate, config changes through to merge, tickets off the board, automation that takes the next repetitive job off everyone's plate. The watching is the floor of this role, not the ceiling.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">The NOC you would be joining is not a legacy one. We are building it as an AI assisted operations environment from the ground up. The forwarding plane runs on open source routing and forwarding software, every device configuration lives in Git, and an LLM layer sits on top of the live network state. When something moves, that layer reads the telemetry, correlates it against the topology and the config history, and puts a probable cause and a candidate fix in front of the engineer on shift. The point is not to replace your judgment. It is to collapse the time between an alert firing and you knowing where to look, so mean time to repair is measured in minutes.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">You sit inside that system. You use it, you push back on it when it is wrong, and what you catch that it misses is part of how it gets smarter. As we build automation out across the NOC, you are not just a consumer of the tooling. You help write it.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">2. What you'll do<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Watch, and know what you're looking at.<\/strong> Sit on our monitoring stack (Zabbix and Grafana dashboards, flow telemetry, alerting) and actually read it. Confirm the alert is real, gather the facts, and localise the fault: one peer or many, us or upstream, a real outage or a monitoring blip. Your job is to read all of it critically, decide what is actually true, and close out what you can on your own. Every ticket you resolve yourself is one our senior people did not get pulled out of deep work, or out of bed, to deal with.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Keep the network healthy, not just alive.<\/strong> A quiet shift is not an idle one. Run the proactive passes: check that routes are propagating the way they should, that RPKI and filter chains are doing their job, that peering and transit sessions are clean across the edge, that no PoP is drifting toward a capacity wall. Catch the slow degradations that never trip an alert. The day team should inherit a network in a known good state.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Build and automate.<\/strong> The repetitive parts of this job should not stay repetitive. Write the scripts that turn a manual check into a scheduled one. Push our config automation forward (Jinja driven generation, NAPALM or NETCONF\/gNMI against the devices) so changes ship from data, not from memory. When the assistive layer keeps missing the same thing, that is a candidate for automation, and you are well placed to build it during the hours nobody else is online.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Move the work forward.<\/strong> You are part of the network team, working the same board they do. Pick up tickets from the Linear queue, take config changes through review to merge, and keep our source of truth (Nautobot) accurate as the estate changes. Real work lands while East Africa is offline, so the team wakes up further ahead than they went to bed.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Report exactly what is happening.<\/strong> For everything you cannot or should not fix alone, the handoff has to be clean: what is wrong, where, since when, what is affected, whether it is getting worse, and what you have already tried. No guessing dressed up as fact. No \"the internet is down.\" A clear, written incident note a senior engineer can act on the moment they open it, and a tidy handover to the East Africa team at the end of your shift.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Escalate well.<\/strong> Know the ladder cold: what you are cleared to touch, what you must not touch alone, and who to bring in for what. Escalating early on a genuine outage is good judgment. Sitting silently on a problem because you were unsure is the one thing that gets people out of bed angry. Handle what you can, raise the rest fast and clearly, and do not turn either dial too far.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">3. Who we're looking for<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">A network engineer who can stand on their own through a shift, and who treats the quiet hours as time to build rather than time to wait. Pair that with clear reporting, sound judgment about when to bring in help, and the instinct to question a machine's suggestion rather than follow it blindly, and you are who we are looking for.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Must-have<\/p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Strong networking competence, held in your hands rather than on paper.<\/strong> CCNA and well beyond it.
