Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><h1>THE ROLE<\/h1><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">As a Software Engineer on Robot Autonomy, you will make our robots navigate dependably across real customer sites. Our stack works. The gap between working and dependable is the whole job. Every new site tests how a robot understands its surroundings and chooses where to go: a ramp the planner avoids, a narrow passage that exposes a poor route, a gate that changes the map, a person who steps into the robot's path, or localization drift that builds over a long patrol. You treat those cases as the real navigation problem to solve, not as edge cases.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">You'll shape the technical choices behind reliable navigation, from sensor selection, ground segmentation, and traversability estimation to predicting how people and vehicles move and planning safe, efficient routes around them. The system has to work day and night, in challenging weather, across different embodiments and changing site conditions. We measure success by whether the robot completes its patrol on a live site, not by how it performs in simulation.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><h1>WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON<\/h1><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Navigation and path-planning design: how robots represent traversable space, select routes, avoid obstacles, and reach goals across complex sites.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Sensor integration driven by navigation requirements, including what ground segmentation and traversability estimation need in day, night, and challenging weather.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Environment understanding: how the robot distinguishes ground from obstacles and estimates which terrain is safe and practical to traverse.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Behavior prediction: anticipate how people, vehicles, and other dynamic obstacles will move, and plan routes that stay safe and efficient around them.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Field reliability: reproduce failures from deployments, find the root cause, and fix it at the right layer, from sensor data and maps to costmaps, planners, and recovery behaviors.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Planning under imperfect localization: plans that stay useful when the state estimate drifts and the robot must execute routes in tight or dynamic environments, working with the rest of Robot Autonomy on localization and control.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Validation on real robots: logs, simulation, and repeatable field tests to verify that design choices and changes hold across routes, lighting, weather, and site layouts.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">New autonomy capabilities: work with the engineers building the operator application and backend so operator requests and new robot capabilities rest on a sound navigation design.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">The field feedback loop: work closely with forward-deployed engineers to turn site issues into bugs, design changes, and improvements to the navigation stack.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Regular site visits to build a practical understanding of how robots and sensors behave in real operating conditions.<\/p><\/li><\/ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><h1>WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR<\/h1><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">We're looking for an engineer who has taken a robotics system from unreliable to dependable and takes ownership beyond individual tickets. You can explain why you made a navigation design choice and what it costs. When a robot takes a bad route, you can tell whether the planner, the map, the state estimate, or the robot's behavior is at fault, and you fix the right one. You are comfortable in the field and want to understand how robots behave in real customer environments.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><h1>YOUR BACKGROUND:<\/h1><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">A Master's degree or PhD in mechanical engineering, computer science, robotics, electrical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Proven track record building and deploying navigation on ground mobile robots in the real world (3+ years or equivalent depth).<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Hands-on experience with mobile robot navigation and path planning: route or local planning, static and dynamic obstacle avoidance, costmaps, or recovery behaviors.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Understanding of how mapping and localization affect navigation, and the ability to diagnose when a planning issue is actually caused by the map, the state estimate, or robot behavior.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Understanding of how lighting, weather, terrain, and sensor limitations affect perception and navigation, with experience developing or validating systems for demanding real-world conditions.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Hands-on experience with robotics sensors and hardware, especially LiDAR, IMUs, and cameras. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p class=&quot;wnfdnte&quot; data-pm-slice=&quot;1 1 []&quot;&gt;Our Tensix team is building custom AI compute cores, RISC-V CPUs, and chiplet-based architectures for datacenter, edge, and automotive AI. Design Verification Engineers on this team validate compute IP and subsystems and build scalable DV infrastructure to keep verification fast, automated, and production-grade.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;wnfdnte&quot;&gt;This role is hybrid, based out of Toronto, ON, Austin, TX or Belgrade, Serbia.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;wnfdnte&quot;&gt;We welcome candidates at various experience levels for this role. During the interview process, candidates will be assessed for the appropriate level, and offers will align with that level, which may differ from the one in this posting.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;wnfdnte&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;wnfdnte&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Who You Are&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experienced in modern verification methodologies with strong SystemVerilog skills and exposure to structured testbench development.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Comfortable working from block-level to system-level verification and reasoning about microarchitecture behavior from specs and waveforms.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Proficient in Linux environments with Python, or Bash scripting for automate builds, parse logs, manage CI pipelines.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Skilled in coverage-driven verification and confident debugging across RTL, testbench, and workload scenarios.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Motivated by AI hardware and eager to learn verification strategies for new architectures and domains.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What We Need&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul data-list-tree=&quot;true&quot; data-indent=&quot;0&quot; data-border=&quot;1&quot; data-border-radius-top-cap=&quot;0&quot; data-border-radius-bottom-cap=&quot;0&quot;&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Contribute to verification of Tensix IP and subsystems from early planning through tape-out, owning coverage goals and driving them to closure.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build and maintain reusable verification environments, agents, scoreboards, and supporting infrastructure in SystemVerilog and Python.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Develop constrained-random and directed tests and close functional, code, and assertion coverage using data-driven approaches.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Debug complex issues across RTL and testbench while collaborating with design, firmware, compiler, and architecture teams.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Help evolve DV infrastructure including regression flows, CI\/CD integration, EDA compute environments, and reproducible setups.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Nice to have: Exposure to functional safety (FuSa) verification concepts for automotive AI workloads.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Nice to have: Familiarity with formal verification methodologies, SVA (SystemVerilog Assertions), or formal property verification for complex control logic and microarchitectural corner cases.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What You Will Learn&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul data-list-tree=&quot;true&quot; data-indent=&quot;0&quot; data-border=&quot;1&quot; data-border-radius-top-cap=&quot;0&quot; data-border-radius-bottom-cap=&quot;0&quot;&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;How Tenstorrent verifies AI-native compute architectures including Tensix cores, RISC-V CPUs, matrix units, vector units, and datapath.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;How simulation, emulation, and software-driven workloads combine to validate both functional correctness and performance.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;How numerical precision formats such as BF16, FP4, and INT8 and on-chip dataflow impact verification complexity and coverage strategy.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;How to build scalable DV infrastructure across hybrid compute environments including containerized regression systems.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;How data analytics and modern AI tooling can enhance verification workflows and accelerate convergence.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;wnfdnte&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Compensation for all engineers at Tenstorrent ranges from $100k - $500k including base and variable compensation targets. Our Swiss offices are at the heart of Artefact\u2019s growth, advising clients on their most pressing strategic challenges \u2014 from AI strategy and governance to digital transformation roadmaps and new business model design.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;Main Responsibilities&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As a Senior Consultant in our Zurich\/Lausanne office, you will work at the intersection of strategy consulting and data and AI delivery. You will:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Strategy Development:&lt;\/strong&gt; Work with client leadership teams to address high-stakes questions. How can AI reshape our business model? How should we govern and organise for data? Which strategic programmes deliver the most impact?&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Structured Problem-Solving:&lt;\/strong&gt; Break complex challenges down into decisions a client can act on, combining consulting rigour with a working knowledge of what current AI can and cannot actually do.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Solution Design:&lt;\/strong&gt; Turn a business question into a solution shape \u2014 what data it depends on, what kind of platform or product it should sit on, and what \u201cgood\u201d looks like once it is built. You will do this alongside our data scientists and engineers.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Project Delivery:&lt;\/strong&gt; Support engagements end to end, from hypothesis framing and market and competitor analysis through to data maturity assessments, client workshops, governance design and implementation roadmaps.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Client Engagement:&lt;\/strong&gt; Work closely with C-level stakeholders and business unit leaders. You will build trusted relationships, communicate recommendations with clarity, and keep the work aligned to what the client is actually trying to decide.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Knowledge &amp;amp; Practice Building:&lt;\/strong&gt; Contribute to the growth of Artefact&#39;s Zurich office by shaping new offerings, creating intellectual capital - frameworks, thought pieces, benchmarks - and taking part in business development.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;Candidate Profile&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for someone who can hold a technical position and a commercial one at the same time. The strongest candidates meet most of the following.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Education:&lt;\/strong&gt; A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Business, Economics or a related field.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Work Experience:&lt;\/strong&gt; Around three to five years in consulting, or in a technical\/date-focussed role with client-facing responsibility.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Business Acumen &amp;amp; AI Fluency:&lt;\/strong&gt; A genuine dual affinity for business and technology. You are comfortable with modern data and AI concepts - generative AI and LLMs, retrieval, predictive machine learning, cloud platforms - and with what they cost and where they fail, not only with what they are called.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Technical Depth:&lt;\/strong&gt; You have built AI or data products, not only advised on them. You can explain why you chose which model you put on which part of the work, and what that choice did to both output quality and cost. You will not be writing production code in this role, but you should have the basic understanding.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Analytical &amp;amp; Problem-Solving Skills:&lt;\/strong&gt; Strong quantitative and analytical skills, and the judgement to know which number actually decides the question. You can expect to contribute to key technical decisions relating to our data ingestion, processing, and query pipelines.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What You\u2019ll Do:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build a query engine that supports efficient relationship traversals for our most demanding workloads.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Contribute to design and drive high-priority, high-visibility projects to increase the platform&#39;s value, resilience, and scalability across multiple teams.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead and guide other engineers through architectural platform decisions&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Identify potential system risks and trends in reliability and design solutions to address them&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Provide input on prioritizing engineering-led initiatives in short- and long-term planning and roadmaps&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Collaborate with internal product teams to understand their requirements and how we plan for their product growth as they integrate and depend on REDAPL&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Who You Are:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You have a BS\/MS\/PhD in a Computer Science, contributed to initiatives in a platform or infrastructure-focused environment for several years&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You have led impactful technical initiatives in an environment where performance, cost efficiency, ease of use, and resilience\/operability are first-order concerns&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You have significant back-end engineering experience and have built, and operated distributed systems to solve problems at a high scale&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Bonus points:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You have experience working with Graph Databases such as Neo4j, Memgraph, JanusGraph, ArangoDB, Amazon Neptune or PuppyGraph.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You have production-grade experience with Apache Iceberg&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You have a solid grasp of query planning or better yet - contributed to a production-grade query engines or related projects (e.g. Trino, Calcite, Substrait, DataFusion, etc) ideally demonstrated through open-source contributions or PMC membership on projects.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That&#39;s okay. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world\u2019s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ\u2019s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including &lt;u&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/cts.businesswire.com\/ct\/CT?id=smartlink&amp;amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&amp;amp;esheet=54451094&amp;amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;amp;lan=en-US&amp;amp;anchor=Amazon+Web+Services%2C&amp;amp;index=8&amp;amp;md5=a7f94ee9b71a392dca3cd6c413722e51&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;Amazon Web Services, &lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;u&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/cts.businesswire.com\/ct\/CT?id=smartlink&amp;amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&amp;amp;esheet=54451094&amp;amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;amp;lan=en-US&amp;amp;anchor=and&amp;amp;index=9&amp;amp;md5=2bed627b388878763f41ffe0e4edb16c&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;and &lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;u&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/cts.businesswire.com\/ct\/CT?id=smartlink&amp;amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&amp;amp;esheet=54451094&amp;amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;amp;lan=en-US&amp;amp;anchor=AstraZeneca&amp;amp;index=10&amp;amp;md5=757c1f2c2ec94cf3982700106122164f&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;AstraZeneca&lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/u&gt; achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, &lt;u&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/cts.businesswire.com\/ct\/CT?id=smartlink&amp;amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-achieves-landmark-result-setting-new-world-record-in-quantum-computing&amp;amp;esheet=54451094&amp;amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;amp;lan=en-US&amp;amp;anchor=setting+a+world+record+in+quantum+computing+performance&amp;amp;index=11&amp;amp;md5=32e9cb88afbd439026a352666cc72c91&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;setting a world record in quantum computing performance&lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/u&gt;.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. &amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What to expect&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The Platform Engineering team builds, secures and operates scalable infrastructure supporting cloud-managed SaaS products with on-premises components deployed at customer sites.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As our Staff DevSecOps Engineer, you will provide the technical leadership for our software factory, defining how software is built, secured and released across the organisation. You will own the roadmap, architecture and tooling that enable every engineering team to deliver software securely, consistently and at scale, while remaining hands-on with automation, infrastructure and platform engineering.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Working closely with Architecture, Site Reliability Engineering, Cloud Operations and Product Development, you will drive an automation-first culture where secure software delivery, developer experience and operational excellence are embedded into every stage of the software lifecycle.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Define and evolve the software factory, including CI\/CD platforms, release engineering, developer tooling, Infrastructure as Code, dependency management and software supply-chain security.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Deliver secure-by-default engineering practices through automated security controls, policy enforcement, vulnerability management, compliance automation and AI-driven workflows.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Mentor engineers, establish engineering standards and collaborate across technical teams to deliver scalable, secure and highly automated development platforms.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you&#39;ll be doing&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will lead the design, implementation and operation of the organisation&#39;s DevSecOps platform, ensuring software moves securely and efficiently from commit to production. You will develop reusable CI\/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code modules and self-service developer capabilities that improve productivity whilst maintaining the highest security standards.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will own release management, dependency and supply-chain security, security operations and hybrid infrastructure consistency across cloud and on-premises environments. You will also drive the adoption of agentic automation and AI-enabled workflows to reduce manual effort, improve operational efficiency and enhance software delivery.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Own the software-factory roadmap, CI\/CD platform, release engineering, Infrastructure as Code, internal developer platform and software supply-chain security.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Embed security throughout the delivery pipeline through automated scanning, policy enforcement, vulnerability management, secrets management and continuous compliance.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Develop agentic automation for pipeline operations, dependency management, release processes and operational support, while providing technical leadership, mentoring and engineering governance.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you&#39;ll bring&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You are an experienced DevSecOps or Platform Engineering leader with more than eight years of production engineering experience and recent hands-on responsibility for building and operating enterprise-scale CI\/CD platforms.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You have designed production Infrastructure as Code, embedded security into delivery pipelines and delivered measurable improvements across software delivery, release management, dependency governance or vulnerability remediation. You are passionate about automation and continuously removing manual effort through tooling, scripting and intelligent workflows.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;8+ years of production engineering experience with recent hands-on responsibility for enterprise-scale CI\/CD platforms, Infrastructure as Code and production automation.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Proven experience embedding security into software delivery through automated scanning, policy enforcement, vulnerability management and measurable operational improvements.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Strong scripting and automation skills, with a demonstrated ability to simplify complex operational processes through reusable tooling and automation.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;You&#39;ll be a great fit with&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You have deep expertise in modern software supply-chain security, internal developer platforms and secure software delivery. You understand how to balance developer productivity with governance, compliance and operational resilience, while creating platforms that engineering teams enjoy using.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You bring practical experience of AI-enabled software delivery, modern release engineering and cloud-native platform design, with a passion for building secure, scalable and highly automated engineering ecosystems.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Proven expertise in software supply-chain security, including artefact signing, Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs), provenance and SLSA principles.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Experience designing internal developer platforms, self-service engineering capabilities and release management processes, including expedited production releases.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Hands-on experience with agentic automation, AI or LLM security, and intelligent workflow orchestration within modern DevSecOps environments.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. In this hands-on role, you will design, validate, and continuously improve mechanical enclosures and subsystems that integrate optical and electronic components for our quantum products.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will take ownership of mechanical solutions from early prototyping through to industrialized product release, with a strong focus on delivering compact, robust, and cost-effective designs. Your work will ensure compliance with dimensional, thermal, and manufacturability requirements, including for highly demanding applications such as cryogenic systems.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What You&#39;ll be Doing&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will be responsible for the mechanical development of cutting-edge quantum systems, translating requirements into detailed designs and verified assemblies. This includes 3D modelling and documentation, engineering calculations and simulations, and hands-on testing to validate thermal dissipation and mechanical performance. You will collaborate closely with optical, electronic, and system engineers to optimise interfaces and block specifications, and you will engage with external suppliers to prototype and manufacture parts efficiently. As a senior contributor, you will help improve design practices, promote a rigorous engineering approach, and support multiple projects as a mechanical subject-matter expert.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own mechanical design from prototype to industrialised product, including CAD documentation, assembly bring-up, and validation testing&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Drive thermal management (heat sinking, conduction\/convection, interfaces and materials), dimensional stability, and manufacturability through design, simulation, and optimization, working closely with cross-functional teams and suppliers&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Perform thermal simulation to predict temperatures, gradients, and heat flows; correlate models with lab measurements and iterate designs and their optimization accordingly&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you&#39;ll Bring&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for a candidate with a Bachelor\u2019s or Master\u2019s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Microtechnology, or equivalent, and at least five years of relevant experience in mechanical design and product development. You have hands-on experience designing with sheet metal and\/or machined parts, and a strong ability to develop thermal dissipation solutions for compact systems. Familiarity with cryogenic systems is an advantage.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You are rigorous, organised, and proactive, able to work independently while collaborating effectively in a multidisciplinary and Agile environment. Strong communication skills are essential, with fluency in English required; French is considered a plus.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Solid mechanical engineering foundation with proven experience delivering compact, industrial-grade designs&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Structured, collaborative engineer with strong communication skills and a hands-on approach to validation&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Knowledge of applicable norms and compliance requirements, including EMC and electrical\/product safety aspects&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;You&#39;ll be a great fit if:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You bring a track record of taking ownership of mechanical subsystems across multiple development phases\u2014requirements, design, verification, and industrialisation\u2014and you are comfortable acting as the mechanical reference point within a multidisciplinary R&amp;amp;D team. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. &amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Location:&lt;\/strong&gt; This role is based onsite in Geneva, Switzerland.&lt;br&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Travel:&lt;\/strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;Job ID:&lt;\/strong&gt; 1893&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;ID Quantique (IDQ), part of IonQ, is a global leader in quantum-safe communications. We provide solutions to protect governments, telecommunication infrastructures, and banking &amp;amp; financial institutions from the \u201charvest-now, decrypt-later\u201d threat, delivering both terrestrial and space-based quantum-safe networks in live operation globally.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The Role:&amp;nbsp;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for a Staff Cryptography Engineer to join our team building post-quantum cryptography (PQC) hardware acceleration for HSM and network-appliance products. You will implement the software side of modern post-quantum algorithms: reference models, optimised implementations, and the test infrastructure that proves they are correct. This is a hands-on development role at the heart of applied cryptography, working with some of the most experienced cryptographic engineers in the field.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Responsibilities&lt;\/strong&gt;:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will implement and maintain reference and bit-accurate models of ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA\/LMS in C\/C++\/Rust and Python, develop constant-time software implementations of cryptographic functions, and build out the known-answer-test and test-vector tooling (NIST ACVP) used for verification and CAVP certification. You will contribute to the decomposition of algorithms into hardware-friendly building blocks (Keccak, NTT and polynomial arithmetic, samplers, encode\/decode), support RTL and firmware engineers with algorithm questions and debugging, and help evaluate third-party cryptographic libraries, working under the guidance of our senior cryptography engineers.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Implement reference models, optimised software and test-vector infrastructure for ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA\/LMS&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Support hardware and firmware teams with algorithm expertise, debugging and certification-oriented tooling&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Requirements:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for a candidate with a Master\u2019s degree (PhD a plus) in Cryptography, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related field and at least five years of experience implementing cryptographic algorithms or security-critical software in C\/C++ or Rust. You have solid understanding of modern cryptographic primitives and ideally first exposure to post-quantum schemes (lattice-based or hash-based) and their underlying mathematics.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You care about correctness and write well-tested, readable code; you understand what constant-time implementation means and why it matters. Familiarity with NIST test-vector formats, CAVP\/ACVP or certification-oriented development is a plus. Fluency in English is required; French or German is an advantage.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Hands-on developer of cryptographic or security-critical software with strong C\/C++\/Rust skills&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Solid cryptographic foundations with the ambition to build deep post-quantum expertise&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Preferred Qualifications:&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You want to grow into a world-class applied cryptographer by working on real products with demanding correctness and security requirements, and you enjoy the discipline of code that must be provably right.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What We Offer:&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A role at one of the fastest growing and most exciting quantum companies in the world&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A competitive compensation scheme, benefits package, and equity plan designed to reward excellence&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Flexible work models that let you balance your life, your family, and your career&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ongoing training and development to keep your skills sharp and your growth on track&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A career development plan within the IonQ group\u2019s companies&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A dynamic, close-knit environment where you collaborate with a global team of experts&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A performance-driven culture built on trust, teamwork, and shared ambition&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. You will help optimise product lifecycle processes, ensuring efficient collaboration, smooth feature delivery and successful execution from concept through to launch.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;Own product operations, ensuring features are defined, tracked throughout the product lifecycle and delivered across cross-functional teams.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;Translate market and customer insights into product features, while triaging, planning and coordinating special customer projects.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;Partner with Engineering, Industrialisation, Production and Marketing to optimise product lifecycle processes and drive efficient product delivery.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you&#39;ll be doing:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;You will take ownership of the operational delivery of product management, ensuring products and features progress efficiently from validated requirements through development, industrialisation and commercialisation. This role is integral to enabling the Product team to scale effectively, providing operational ownership and supporting the successful delivery of an expanding product portfolio.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;Own the operational delivery of product management, ensuring features progress from validated requirements through development, industrialisation and commercialisation.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;Drive cross-functional alignment, maintain product data integrity and coordinate timely delivery across the product lifecycle.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;Act as the day-to-day product decision-maker within defined boundaries, enabling the Product team to scale beyond a single Product Manager.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you&#39;ll bring:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;In this role, you will take ownership of feature delivery from end to end, defining requirements and acceptance criteria, coordinating engineering handovers, validating delivery and supporting successful commercial launches. You will manage non-standard sales opportunities by assessing feasibility, making configuration decisions within agreed boundaries and documenting exceptions, while ensuring full traceability from customer requests through to delivered capability. Working closely with Engineering, Industrialisation, Production, Marketing and Sales, you will coordinate cross-functional activities to remove blockers, maintain an accurate and prioritised Jira backlog, and respond to product enquiries from Sales. You will also prepare products for launch through documentation, training, pricing and sales enablement, maintain up-to-date product documentation, communicate complex photonic, cryogenic and networking architectures to a range of stakeholders, and represent the product in customer-facing activities including pre-sales support, technical discussions and trade shows.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;Own end-to-end feature delivery, from requirements definition and engineering handover through to delivery validation, commercial launch and ongoing product documentation.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;Coordinate cross-functionally with Engineering, Industrialisation, Production, Marketing and Sales, while managing Jira backlog integrity, product enquiries and non-standard sales opportunities.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;Support successful product adoption by communicating complex technical architectures, ensuring launch readiness, providing pre-sales support and representing the product in customer discussions and at trade shows.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;You&#39;ll be a great fit with:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;The ideal candidate will hold a Master&#39;s degree in Engineering, Physics, Photonics, Microengineering or a related technical discipline, combined with an action-oriented mindset and the confidence to make decisions in an environment of uncertainty. You will be able to understand and reason about complex hardware products involving photonics, cryogenics and networking technologies, while communicating effectively with both technical and commercial stakeholders. You will be comfortable representing products in customer-facing situations, including technical discussions, pre-sales meetings and trade shows, and have a strong understanding of manufacturing environments, including industrialisation constraints, production realities and supply chain considerations. You will also be confident resolving conflicting priorities, negotiating with stakeholders and developing deep expertise in quantum technologies, supported by advanced Jira proficiency, including workflow configuration, automation rules and custom field management.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;Master&#39;s degree in Engineering, Physics, Photonics, Microengineering or a related technical discipline, with the ability to make product decisions autonomously within defined boundaries.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;Strong technical, commercial and customer-facing communication skills, with experience discussing complex hardware products and representing products in pre-sales meetings and trade shows.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;Advanced Jira expertise, manufacturing and industrialisation knowledge, excellent stakeholder management and negotiation skills, and a genuine curiosity for deep-tech and quantum technologies.&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;If you are interested in being a part of our team and mission, we encourage you to apply!&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;<p>Find <a href=\"https:\/\/www.arbeitnow.ch\">Jobs in Switzerland<\/a> on Arbeitnow<\/a>","remote":false,"url":"https:\/\/www.arbeitnow.ch\/jobs\/companies\/ionq\/product-manager-geneva-372402","tags":["Quantum Platform"],"job_types":[],"location":"Geneva","created_at":1790585728},{"slug":"principal-engineer-classical-cryptography-architecture-geneva-111024","company_name":"ionq","title":"Principal Engineer - Classical Cryptography & Architecture","description":"&lt;div class=&quot;content-intro&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About IonQ:&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;u&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/cts.businesswire.com\/ct\/CT?id=smartlink&amp;amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2F&amp;amp;esheet=54451094&amp;amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;amp;lan=en-US&amp;amp;anchor=IonQ%2C+Inc&amp;amp;index=7&amp;amp;md5=0818ffbedc6dbad8c4d1611ac94c2a0f&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;IonQ, Inc&lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/u&gt;. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world\u2019s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ\u2019s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including &lt;u&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/cts.businesswire.com\/ct\/CT?id=smartlink&amp;amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&amp;amp;esheet=54451094&amp;amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;amp;lan=en-US&amp;amp;anchor=Amazon+Web+Services%2C&amp;amp;index=8&amp;amp;md5=a7f94ee9b71a392dca3cd6c413722e51&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;Amazon Web Services, &lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;u&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/cts.businesswire.com\/ct\/CT?id=smartlink&amp;amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&amp;amp;esheet=54451094&amp;amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;amp;lan=en-US&amp;amp;anchor=and&amp;amp;index=9&amp;amp;md5=2bed627b388878763f41ffe0e4edb16c&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;and &lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;u&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/cts.businesswire.com\/ct\/CT?id=smartlink&amp;amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&amp;amp;esheet=54451094&amp;amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;amp;lan=en-US&amp;amp;anchor=AstraZeneca&amp;amp;index=10&amp;amp;md5=757c1f2c2ec94cf3982700106122164f&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;AstraZeneca&lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/u&gt; achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, &lt;u&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/cts.businesswire.com\/ct\/CT?id=smartlink&amp;amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-achieves-landmark-result-setting-new-world-record-in-quantum-computing&amp;amp;esheet=54451094&amp;amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;amp;lan=en-US&amp;amp;anchor=setting+a+world+record+in+quantum+computing+performance&amp;amp;index=11&amp;amp;md5=32e9cb88afbd439026a352666cc72c91&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;setting a world record in quantum computing performance&lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/u&gt;.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. &amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Location:&lt;\/strong&gt; This role is based onsite in Geneva, Switzerland.&lt;br&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Travel:&lt;\/strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;Job ID:&lt;\/strong&gt; 1892&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;ID Quantique (IDQ), part of IonQ, is a global leader in quantum-safe communications. We provide solutions to protect governments, telecommunication infrastructures, and banking &amp;amp; financial institutions from the \u201charvest-now, decrypt-later\u201d threat, delivering both terrestrial and space-based quantum-safe networks in live operation globally.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The Role:&amp;nbsp;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for a Principal Engineer to own the classical cryptography architecture of our post-quantum cryptography (PQC) hardware acceleration products, targeting hardware security module (HSM) and network-appliance applications. Real-world quantum-safe systems are hybrid systems: classical and post-quantum algorithms operating side by side, with careful key management, crypto agility and migration paths. You will be the senior authority for this classical and hybrid layer, working alongside our PQC architecture leadership. The role demands fluency on both sides of the transition: deep classical mastery combined with a solid working command of the post-quantum algorithms and standards the products are built around.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Responsibilities&lt;\/strong&gt;:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will own the architecture and implementation strategy of the classical cryptographic functions of the product line: symmetric ciphers and modes (AES\/GCM and beyond), hash functions (SHA-2\/SHA-3, HMAC\/KDF constructions), RSA\/ECC offload, and true random number generation and entropy architecture (SP 800-90A\/B\/C). You will define the hybrid classical\/post-quantum schemes (key establishment, dual signatures, composite certificates) and the crypto-agility mechanisms that allow customers to migrate safely, track the standardisation of hybrid and composite approaches (NIST guidance, IETF work on hybrid key establishment in TLS 1.3 and IKEv2, composite certificates) together with our PQC architects, guide RTL and software engineers implementing classical cores, technically evaluate third-party IP, and support FIPS 140-3 and CAVP certification of the classical algorithm suite. You will also own key-management and key-hierarchy architecture across the product, ensuring interoperability with deployed HSM, TLS and IPsec ecosystems.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own the classical and hybrid cryptography architecture of the product line: symmetric, hash, RSA\/ECC, entropy and key management, and classical\/PQC hybrid schemes&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Define crypto-agility and migration mechanisms that let customers move to quantum-safe deployments without breaking existing infrastructure&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Requirements:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for a candidate with a Master\u2019s or PhD in Cryptography, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field and at least twelve years of experience implementing and architecting classical cryptography in real products, in hardware, software or both. You have deep command of symmetric and asymmetric primitives, modes of operation, key management and entropy generation, and you have taken cryptographic subsystems through FIPS 140-3 or Common Criteria evaluation. You also bring a solid working knowledge of the NIST post-quantum algorithms (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA) and their deployment constraints: you do not need to be a lattice specialist, but you must be able to architect hybrid schemes with one.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You understand the practical constraints of deployed security infrastructure (HSMs, PKI, TLS and IPsec ecosystems) and how hybrid classical\/post-quantum schemes are standardised and deployed in practice. You write precise specifications, guide implementers effectively, and make sound architecture decisions under real-world interoperability constraints. Fluency in English is required; French or German is an advantage.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Proven architect of classical cryptographic subsystems with certification experience (FIPS 140-3, CAVP, Common Criteria)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Practical knowledge of hybrid classical\/PQC schemes, crypto agility and key-management architecture, with working command of the NIST PQC standards&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Preferred Qualifications:&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You believe that quantum-safe security is only as strong as the classical foundations it stands on. You enjoy being the guardian of correctness and interoperability in a programme pushing new technology, and you take pride in migrations that customers barely notice because they simply work.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What We Offer:&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A role at one of the fastest growing and most exciting quantum companies in the world&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A competitive compensation scheme, benefits package, and equity plan designed to reward excellence&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Flexible work models that let you balance your life, your family, and your career&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ongoing training and development to keep your skills sharp and your growth on track&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A career development plan within the IonQ group\u2019s companies&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A dynamic, close-knit environment where you collaborate with a global team of experts&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A performance-driven culture built on trust, teamwork, and shared ambition&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental\/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;If you are interested in being a part of our team and mission, we encourage you to apply!&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;<p>Find <a href=\"https:\/\/www.arbeitnow.ch\">Jobs in Switzerland<\/a> on Arbeitnow<\/a>","remote":false,"url":"https:\/\/www.arbeitnow.ch\/jobs\/companies\/ionq\/principal-engineer-classical-cryptography-architecture-geneva-111024","tags":["Quantum Platform - Network and Security"],"job_types":[],"location":"Geneva","created_at":1790585728},{"slug":"distinguished-pqc-cryptography-architecture-leader-geneva-120703","company_name":"ionq","title":"Distinguished PQC Cryptography & Architecture Leader","description":"&lt;div class=&quot;content-intro&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About IonQ:&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;u&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/cts.businesswire.com\/ct\/CT?id=smartlink&amp;amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2F&amp;amp;esheet=54451094&amp;amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;amp;lan=en-US&amp;amp;anchor=IonQ%2C+Inc&amp;amp;index=7&amp;amp;md5=0818ffbedc6dbad8c4d1611ac94c2a0f&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;IonQ, Inc&lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/u&gt;. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. &amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Location:&lt;\/strong&gt; This role is based onsite in Geneva, Switzerland.&lt;br&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Travel:&lt;\/strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;Job ID:&lt;\/strong&gt; 1891&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;ID Quantique (IDQ), part of IonQ, is a global leader in quantum-safe communications. We provide solutions to protect governments, telecommunication infrastructures, and banking &amp;amp; financial institutions from the \u201charvest-now, decrypt-later\u201d threat, delivering both terrestrial and space-based quantum-safe networks in live operation globally.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The Role:&amp;nbsp;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for a Distinguished Leader to provide the overall technical leadership for our post-quantum cryptography (PQC) hardware acceleration programme, part of our quantum-safe product portfolio targeting hardware security module (HSM) and network-appliance applications. As the most senior technical authority of the programme, you will own the end-to-end architecture, from cryptographic algorithm and standards strategy to an FPGA-based product architecture with a clear path to ASIC, and you will set the technical direction across the cryptography, hardware, software and security disciplines involved. This is a rare opportunity to shape a strategic security product line at one of the few companies where quantum-safe security is the core business.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Responsibilities&lt;\/strong&gt;:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will define the system architecture and microarchitecture of a multi-algorithm PQC accelerator implementing ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA\/LMS: hardware\/firmware partitioning, throughput and lane sizing derived from real customer traffic models, and a stable core-interface specification that lets cryptographic cores evolve behind a frozen contract. You will own the algorithm and standards strategy (NIST FIPS 203\/204\/205, CNSA 2.0, FIPS 140-3), drive make\/buy and IP-licensing decisions, and shape the security and certification architecture together with our side-channel and compliance specialists. You will set the technical roadmap, arbitrate the hardest cross-domain design decisions, mentor the senior engineers who own each domain, and represent the programme externally with customers, standards bodies, certification laboratories and executive stakeholders.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own the end-to-end architecture and technical roadmap of a PQC hardware-acceleration product line (algorithms, microarchitecture, interfaces, and security\/certification strategy) from concept to shipping product&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Act as the programme\u2019s most senior technical authority: set direction across disciplines, mentor senior engineers, and represent the technology with customers, standards bodies and executives&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Requirements:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for a candidate with a Master\u2019s or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Cryptography or a related field and fifteen or more years of experience architecting complex digital security hardware, including deep, hands-on exposure to cryptographic implementation with genuine post-quantum depth. You are a recognised authority in your field, evidenced by shipped market-defining security products, contributions to standards, publications or patents, and you have taken accelerators, secure elements or HSM-class systems from specification to production more than once.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You are equally credible discussing lattice-based cryptography with a cryptographer, timing closure with an FPGA designer, and certification strategy with a FIPS laboratory, and you can defend an architecture in front of a demanding customer or executive committee. You make well-reasoned build\/buy\/partner decisions under uncertainty and raise the technical bar of everyone around you. Fluency in English is required; French or German is an advantage.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Recognised architect of cryptographic or security hardware products, with authoritative depth in PQC algorithms and standards (FIPS 203\/204\/205, CNSA 2.0, FIPS 140-3)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Distinguished-level technical leadership: sets direction across domains, mentors senior specialists, and represents the company externally&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Preferred Qualifications:&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You thrive on ambiguity and ownership, turning a strategic mandate into an architecture, a plan and a working product. You lead through technical authority and clarity rather than hierarchy, you hold quality and security to an uncompromising standard, and you are motivated by building products that will help define quantum-safe infrastructure for the next decade.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;What We Offer:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A role at one of the fastest growing and most exciting quantum companies in the world&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A competitive compensation scheme, benefits package, and equity plan designed to reward excellence&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Flexible work models that let you balance your life, your family, and your career&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ongoing training and development to keep your skills sharp and your growth on track&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A career development plan within the IonQ group\u2019s companies&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A dynamic, close-knit environment where you collaborate with a global team of experts&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A performance-driven culture built on trust, teamwork, and shared ambition&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental\/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect.
